title: Mute Snapshots
author: Cere, made with Claude
description: Four mute snapshots, after the Octatrack's mute scenes. Hold YES and press trig 1-4 to save the 16 tracks' mutes as snapshot 1-4; hold NO and press trig 1-4 to recall it at the end of the bar (at once when stopped). The same keys again before the bar cancel it. M1-M4 shows top-right while a recall waits. Snapshots are kept on the unit. Needs seq-events.
